title: [Subcontracting] Detect subcontracting purchase/transfer orders in legacy data check
summary: The legacy data check for subcontracting now detects production-order-linked purchase and transfer orders to ensure migration runs when needed, and renames an internal function for clarity.
key_points: Adds detection for subcontracting purchase orders linked to production orders
Adds detection for subcontracting transfer orders linked to production orders
Renames internal function OpenSubcontractingTransfersExist to OpenWIPTransfersExist for accuracy
Fixes migration gaps where legacy data existed but was not detected
Includes new tests to verify detection of linked orders without WIP Item flag
quote: The migration check missed them as a result, disabling Legacy Subcontracting skipped a needed data migration.
